notifications.title: Let the evaluator rank voices by what viewers hear
notifications.detail: Research's evaluate-voice-heard: 'voice' in the evaluator names only the narrator, but in our best Shorts the cast speaks 80-100% of the words. Manifests now carry heard.hookVoice and heard.narratorShare (from tonight's ship code). improvement/evaluate.py is owner-only, so the ranking is yours to add. Measured on today's data from the scripts: hook voice am_fenrir (Sharma) 15.8x median 48 h views (n=4), narrator 0-24% of words 31.2x (n=3) vs 75-100% 0.66x (n=5).
notifications.fix: 1. In improvement/evaluate.py attributes(), add two keys: (lambda v: v.get('hookVoice'), 'hook voice') and the narrator share in quarters, (lambda v: <'0-24% of words' … '75-100% of words'>, 'narrator'). 2. Fill them in report(): for each row without narratorShare, read videos/<id>/script.json and take the first spoken beat's voice (CAST_VOICES from renderer/timeline/build.py, else render.json voice.name) and the narrator's share of words; generator.run.heard(script, narrator) already computes both. 3. Add a test in improvement/tests/test_evaluate.py.

notifications.title: An extended experiment is abandoned the next night, with no new data
notifications.detail: improvement/evaluate.py judge(): the wait branch is `n < min_per_arm and days < max_days`, so once both arms have minPerArm videos the maxDays an extension adds is never used, and `extended: true` returns abandon at once. Tonight hook-voice-matches-frame got 'extend' (on 9, off 8, no clear effect); with extended set and maxDays 28 it already reads 'abandon'. The improver can't change evaluate.py (owner-only), so tomorrow's run will abandon it unless this is fixed.
notifications.fix: 1. In improvement/evaluate.py judge(), before the keep/revert checks, add: `if exp.get('extended') and days < max_days: return {**out, 'verdict': 'wait', 'why': f'extended to {max_days} days; day {days}'}`. 2. Add a case to improvement/tests/test_evaluate.py test_extends_then_abandons_when_unclear: extended with maxDays beyond NOW waits, past it abandons. 3. If you'd rather drop extensions, change the extend message instead, and the improver will abandon on the first unclear verdict.

notifications.title: Carry loudness into metrics/videos.json so the evaluator can rank by it
notifications.detail: From tonight every render.json and manifest has audio.lufs (integrated loudness) and audio.music_under_voice_db (research loudness-in-render-json, adopted). metrics/videos.json is written by the ingest worker and ranked by improvement/evaluate.py, neither in the improver's lane.
notifications.fix: 1. In the ingest worker that writes metrics/videos.json, copy manifest.audio.lufs and manifest.audio.music_under_voice_db into each row (the auditor can do this if you add it to its focus). 2. In improvement/evaluate.py attributes(), add a 'music under voice' bucket (under 15 dB, 15-20, 20+).
